snippet.title: DREAD FIELDS - Release Date Announcement [Rural Horror Game]
snippet.description:
May 28th on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4258770/Dread_Fields/

DREAD FIELDS
You bought an isolated farm to start a new life. Your peaceful routine is shattered when the former owner's terrible secrets rise from beneath the ground. A slow-burn rural horror.

THE GAME IN WHICH RURAL ROUTINE MEETS MYSTICISM AND DARKNESS.

Steam Developer: https://store.steampowered.com/developer/podoba
Twitter (X): https://x.com/notifications
